posts.body:
My daughter and son-in-law are expecting their first child in December and we are struggling to find shops that have prams/pushchairs on display.  Obviously they could buy online, but would really like to find somewhere where they can actually see them and try pushing/folding them etc before buying.

The only store we have found is John Lewis, which has some beautiful prams but only has the most expensive brands (the cheapest one is £750!) 

Obviously there are no Mothercare stores anymore, the only Mamas and Papas store within 2 hours drive has closed, there used to be an independent baby shop but that’s gone online only 🤷🏻‍♀️  Where do people go to see baby equipment before purchasing these days?
